summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone barrage against Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, employing ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonics, and Shahed drones, resulting in at least five injuries in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district and the destruction of the Epicentr hypermarket. Ukrainian air defenses engaged across at least ten oblasts, with multiple air alerts at red and yellow levels. Concurrently, the Kremlin signaled readiness to resume trilateral talks with Ukraine and the U.S. in November, while Russia released a detained American citizen.
key_points: Russia fired three ballistic missiles at Kyiv and struck CHPP-5 and several western districts, causing casualties and infrastructure damage (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77369).
Two Zircon hypersonic missiles were launched from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77393).
A high threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was reported (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77391).
Ukrainian air defense shot down a reactive Shahed over Vinnytsia region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77390).
Russian forces attacked the Metro hypermarket in Rivne (Source: @UkraineNow/84818).
Three Russian generals were removed on the Pokrovsk direction for false reporting on Dobropillia (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
The Kremlin announced readiness to resume trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi no earlier than November 10 (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915).
Elon Musk reportedly restricted Ukraine's military Starlink access over anger at refinery strikes (Source: @UkraineNow/84807).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone barrage against Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, employing ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonics, and Shahed drones, resulting in at least five injuries in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district and the destruction of the Epicentr hypermarket. Ukrainian air defenses engaged across at least ten oblasts, with multiple air alerts at red and yellow levels. Concurrently, the Kremlin signaled readiness to resume trilateral talks with Ukraine and the U.S. in November, while Russia released a detained American citizen.

points: Ukrainian air defense engaged reactive Shaheds and Geran-5 missiles across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Mykolaiv regions overnight (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408).

Kyiv experienced multiple air alerts: missile threat (red level) at 01:55 and 04:20, drone threat (yellow level) at 04:18 and 05:17, with all-clear signals by 06:28 (Source: @eRadarrua/125431, @eRadarrua/125483, @eRadarrua/125482, @eRadarrua/125484).
In Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district, a ballistic missile hit a service station and private house, debris fell near a gas station, and five people were injured (Source: @UkraineNow/84828).
The Epicentr construction hypermarket on Pochaina Street was destroyed by a ballistic missile strike (Source: @eRadarrua/125491).
HUR reported Russia has stockpiled up to 700 ballistic missiles, several thousand cruise missiles, and over 6,000 strike UAVs for attacks on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84806).
Ukrainian officials discussed the humanitarian situation in Oleshky during Witkoff talks, expecting movement on the humanitarian track next week (Source: @UkraineNow/84823).
Lviv Oblast Council declared 2027 the year of Shukhevych and UPA, drawing Polish condemnation; MFA Ukraine called the decision counterproductive (Source: @UkraineNow/84822).
Russian forces launched three ballistic missiles at Kyiv, targeting CHPP-5 and the Shulyavka, Borshchahivka, Svyatoshyn, and Vydradnyi districts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77397).
Two Zircon hypersonic missiles were fired from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77393).
A high threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was detected (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77391).
Russian Geran-5 missiles were launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district and from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408).
Repeated KAB guided bomb launches were reported on the northeastern Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/89398).
Three Russian generals were dismissed on the Pokrovsk direction for fabricating successes near Dobropillia; Azov denies Russian claims of encircling the city (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
The Kremlin stated readiness to resume trilateral talks with Ukraine and the U.S. in Abu Dhabi no earlier than November 10, and released U.S. citizen Steven Hubbard (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915).
On the Pokrovsk direction, three Russian generals were removed for false reporting on advances near Dobropillia in Donetsk region (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
Azov National Guard unit again denied Russian claims of encirclement and capture of Dobropillia (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
Russian forces conducted repeated KAB guided bomb strikes on the northeastern Kharkiv region, which borders the eastern front (Source: @kpszsu/89398).
No specific ground maneuver details for the eastern front were reported in the messages; the focus remains on air strikes and command changes (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
Two Zircon hypersonic missiles launched from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77393).
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region toward northern Ukraine (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77391).
Multiple reactive Shaheds and Geran-5 missiles traversed Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr regions, with launches from Bryansk and Chernihiv regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408).
A reactive UAV from northern Zhytomyr region moved toward northern Rivne region (Source: @kpszsu/89374).
Reactive UAVs were detected over Chernihiv region near Dovzhik, CHPP, Morivsk, and Slavutych (Source: @eRadarrua/125469).
A reactive Shahed circled over Kharkiv city (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77405).
A reactive UAV from the Black Sea moved toward the Mykolaiv-Odesa border area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77405).
A reactive UAV struck Bashtanka in Mykolaiv region from the northeast (Source: @kpszsu/89392).
A reactive UAV targeted Zaporizhzhia from the south (Source: @kpszsu/89385).
A strike UAV from the Black Sea moved toward southern Mykolaiv region (Source: @kpszsu/89344).
Three Shaheds headed toward Ochakiv in Mykolaiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77374).

Overnight, Russia fired three ballistic missiles at Kyiv, two Zircon hypersonics from Sumy, multiple Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv and Bryansk, and dozens of reactive Shaheds across at least ten oblasts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77369, @mon1tor_ua/77393, @mon1tor_ua/77408).

Kyiv suffered eight impacts on the left bank, with hits on CHPP-5 and western districts; a ballistic missile destroyed the Epicentr hypermarket on Pochaina Street (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77370, @eRadarrua/125491).
Ukrainian air defense shot down a reactive Shahed over Vinnytsia region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77390).

Air alerts in Kyiv: missile threat (red) at 01:55 and 04:20; drone threat (yellow) at 04:18 and 05:17; all cleared by 06:28 (Source: @eRadarrua/125431, @eRadarrua/125483, @eRadarrua/125482, @eRadarrua/125484).
Reactive Shaheds were tracked moving from Rivne to Volyn, Zhytomyr to Rivne, Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi, Cherkasy to Kyiv, Kirovohrad to Vinnytsia, and Odesa to Vinnytsia (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77373).
Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district (5 missiles) and from Bryansk toward Chernihiv district (1 missile) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408).
Repeated KAB guided bomb launches targeted northeastern Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/89398).

key_developments: Massive Russian missile and drone attack overnight: 3 ballistic missiles on Kyiv, 2 Zircons from Sumy, 5 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv, dozens of Shaheds across 10+ oblasts; 5 injured in Kyiv, Epicentr hypermarket destroyed (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77369, @mon1tor_ua/77393, @mon1tor_ua/77408, @UkraineNow/84828, @eRadarrua/125491).

Kremlin announces readiness for trilateral talks with Ukraine and U.S. in Abu Dhabi no earlier than Nov 10; Putin met Witkoff in St. Petersburg, discussed security guarantees and post-war economic plan (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915).

Russia releases U.S. citizen Steven Hubbard detained since 2022; Witkoff calls Putin a humanist, Trump claims war nearing end despite missile barrage (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915, @UkraineNow/84816, @UkraineNow/84827).
Three Russian generals dismissed on Pokrovsk direction for false reporting on Dobropillia; Azov denies Russian encirclement claims (Source: @UkraineNow/84821).
Elon Musk reportedly restricts Ukraine's military Starlink access over anger at Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries; Trump and Musk expressed displeasure (Source: @UkraineNow/84807).
Hungary blocks final two EU accession negotiation clusters for Ukraine and Moldova (clusters 4 and 5) (Source: @UkraineNow/84808).
HUR intelligence: Russia stockpiled up to 700 ballistic missiles, several thousand cruise missiles, and 6,000+ strike UAVs for attacks on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84806).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia maintains a high-intensity air campaign, demonstrating the ability to launch simultaneous ballistic, hypersonic, and drone strikes across Ukraine's depth. The use of Zircon missiles from Sumy region indicates expanded launch platforms. The destruction of the Epicentr hypermarket and hits on critical energy infrastructure (CHPP-5) signal a continued strategy of targeting civilian and economic assets. Despite diplomatic overtures, the missile barrage during Witkoff's visit suggests Russia negotiates from a position of military pressure. Ukraine's air defense remains active but faces saturation challenges across multiple axes.
sections.regional_response: Poland condemned Lviv Oblast's declaration of 2027 as the year of Shukhevych and UPA, highlighting persistent historical sensitivities. Hungary's blockade of EU accession clusters 4 and 5 demonstrates continued political obstacles to Ukraine's integration. The U.S. engages in shuttle diplomacy: Witkoff's meetings in Oslo and St. Petersburg produced a Russian commitment to trilateral talks and a prisoner release, but Trump's rhetoric blaming Ukraine for energy price spikes and Musk's Starlink restrictions reveal friction in the alliance. Regional actors remain divided on both security guarantees and political normalization.
sections.intelligence_notes: HUR's assessment of Russian missile and UAV stockpiles (700 ballistic, thousands of cruise, 6,000+ strike UAVs) indicates sustained strike capacity for months. The appearance of Zircon launches from Sumy region suggests forward deployment or mobile launchers near the border. The dismissal of three generals on the Pokrovsk axis reflects command dysfunction and potential exaggeration of tactical gains. The Epicentr strike precision implies improved targeting of large civilian infrastructure. Starlink restrictions could degrade Ukrainian command and control if prolonged. Monitoring of Geran-5 launch patterns from Chernihiv and Bryansk regions will clarify Russian logistics routes.
